name: Double Struck
description: Converts the text to double-struck (blackboard) letters.
legacyScript:
function cp(n){ if(n<0x10000) return String.fromCharCode(n); n-=0x10000; return String.fromCharCode(0xD800+(n>>10),0xDC00+(n&0x3FF)); }
        function animate(env,el,p){ var M={"C":0x2102,"H":0x210D,"N":0x2115,"P":0x2119,"Q":0x211A,"R":0x211D,"Z":0x2124}; var t=el.text,o=""; for(var i=0;i<t.length;i++){ var ch=t.charAt(i),c=t.charCodeAt(i); if(M[ch]!==undefined){o+=cp(M[ch]);} else if(c>=65&&c<=90){o+=cp(0x1D538+(c-65));} else if(c>=97&&c<=122){o+=cp(0x1D552+(c-97));} else if(c>=48&&c<=57){o+=cp(0x1D7D8+(c-48));} else o+=ch; } el.text=o; return el; }
